notes:
New on Users → Find / list users: there’s a Saved row under the search buttons.

Pick a saved search to load it into the form, then click ▶ Run.
To edit it: change the org units or other settings, then click Update with the search above. It shows the old and new versions before saving.
Rename… and Delete are next to it.

On Home: right-clicking a favorite now gives Run (or Open), Edit the search…, Rename… and Remove from favorites. Edit opens it on the Users page without running it.
